settings.repere: Titre H2 · Born from Frustration, Built on Standard
Paragraphe · The methylene blue market was a mess. Sk
settings.text: The methylene blue market was a mess. Sketchy sources, inconsistent dosing, and zero transparency. So we fixed it. Nutricel was born in 2020 out of personal necessity. Keith Humphrey started it by digging into the published research on methylene blue, and Handel Humphrey joined in 2021. Together they found a gap, and an opportunity to build something better.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · As a family-run company, we source only
settings.text: As a family-run company, we source only pharmaceutical-grade ingredients, manufacture in the USA, and have our capsule formulas tested by independent third-party labs. We're not here to reinvent methylene blue. We're here to set the new standard.
